## Preferred attribution

When quoting, summarizing, referencing, or sharing material from this site:

- Name Ajay Khampariya as the author.
- Include the article title.
- Link to the article's canonical URL on this site.
- Clearly distinguish direct quotations from summaries or commentary.
- Do not attribute claims to the author that the cited article does not support.

Suggested citation format:

Ajay Khampariya, "Article title," Ajay Khampariya's Blog, canonical article URL.

## Usage

Brief quotations and summaries should include attribution and a canonical link. Full republication, dataset inclusion, model-training use, or commercial reuse is not granted by this file; consult the citation and reuse policy.
